caption: The home agent adds a 20-byte outer header, so the 120-byte datagram becomes 140 bytes across the tunnel. The foreign agent removes the outer header and delivers the original 120 bytes; overhead is 16.7%, and 140 bytes take 0.56 ms on a 2 Mbps link.

spec.title: Tunnel: 120 B to 140 B
spec.aria: A packet from the correspondent node goes to the home agent, which adds a 20-byte outer header and tunnels 140 bytes to the foreign agent; the foreign agent removes the header and delivers 120 bytes to the mobile node.
